verdict.rationale: For a GPU accelerator, the public API is AMD's first-party, open-source ROCm stack. The docs cover the HIP runtime and HIP C++ programming model, math, compute and communication libraries, and AMD SMI for programmatic device management and monitoring, with an llms.txt index for AI consumers. A REST/OpenAPI spec is not expected for hardware, so the 404 openapi probe does not count against it. Missing for 10: concrete API reference detail (e.g. HIP/AMD SMI API reference pages) in the evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation that the APIs work in practice.
